rationale: No existing spec covers dashboard print mode/print layout. A grep across tests/ui-testing for print-mode|print-btn|printMode|o2-print-page|print=true|dashboard-print returned zero hits. The closest specs (dashboard-share-link, dashboard-folder) cover share/export and folder management, not the print reflow. Print layout is a distinct feature area within Dashboards, so a dedicated spec is warranted. The spec must be registered in the Dashboards-Core run_files list in .github/workflows/playwright.yml.
